net_socket.reason: The v1.2.2 tag points at 2015 code under the PHP License 2.02, older than v1.2.1; Composer installs it because the version number is higher. v1.2.1 is the newer code, relicensed BSD-2-Clause by both authors.
net_socket.remove_when: pear/Net_Socket tags a BSD-2-Clause release above v1.2.2 and Roundcube installs it

roundcube/rtf-html-php@v2.2.reason: GPL-2.0-only; cannot be combined with GPL-3.0 Roundcube. Optional at runtime: rcube_tnef_decoder skips RTF bodies in TNEF when the class is absent.
roundcube/rtf-html-php@v2.2.remove_when: the Roundcube fork is relicensed GPL-2.0-or-later or MIT (henck/rtf-html-php is MIT since 8e92b5e0)

asset/tinymce-langs@5.10.9.reason: Community TinyMCE language packs carry no license. Roundcube falls back to the built-in English editor strings.
asset/tinymce-langs@5.10.9.remove_when: the packs gain a stated license, or SHCP ships its own editor translations

elastic-viewport-allow-zoom.patch.reason: Elastic sets maximum-scale=1.0 in its viewport meta, which stops pinch-zoom on phones that honour it (Firefox for Android). That fails WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text (axe meta-viewport). Owner decision 2026-10-24, shcp-master#3338.
elastic-viewport-allow-zoom.patch.remove_when: upstream elastic drops maximum-scale from skins/elastic/meta.json; git apply --check then fails on the Roundcube bump and this entry goes with the patch
elastic-viewport-allow-zoom.patch.test: .github/workflows/distribution.yml "Verify core patches": the assembled meta.json carries no maximum-scale
